Application Fee Waivers
The Office of Graduate Education provides Institute-level application fee waivers for participants of the specific programs listed below. To be eligible, you must provide the required documentation at the time of application. Go to “How to Request a Waiver” for more information.
If you don't meet the criteria for an Institute-level waiver, we encourage you to reach out directly to the graduate program you are applying to. They may have department-level fee waivers or other options available.
The Office of Graduate Education does not review or approve requests based on financial hardship for international applicants.
Institute-Level Fee Waivers
Applicants with Financial or Other Hardship
Federal Pell Grant recipient
Website:
Federal Student Aid - Account Login
Documentation Needed:
In the online application, provide a screenshot from your Federal Student Aid account showing your Pell Grant disbursement within the last two years. Your name must be visible in the top right corner of the screen. You can access this info by clicking "View Details" under "My Aid." Select "Grants" and scroll to "Pell Grants by Year."
Perkins or other subsidized loan recipient
Website:
Federal Student Aid - Account Login
Documentation Needed:
In the online application, provide a screenshot from your Federal Student Aid account showing your Perkins or other subsidized loan disbursement within the last two years. Your name must be visible in the top right corner of the screen. You can access this info by clicking "View Details" under "My Aid." Select "Loans," "View Breakdown," "View Loans," and take a screenshot of the Perkins or other subsidized loan details.
SAI of 0 or less
Website:
What is My Student Aid Index (SAI)?
Documentation Needed:
From your most recent FAFSA Application, upload a screenshot showing your Student Aid Index (SAI) of 0 or less (negative values are valid). Your name or other unique identifier must be visible. FAFSA must be less than two years old.
SNAP, SSI, TANF, or WIC recipient
Website(s):
Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP)
Supplemental Security Income (SSI)
Temporary Assistance for Needy Families (TANF)
Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children (WIC)
​​​​​​​Documentation Needed:
In the online application, upload the official award letter showing that you received benefits under one of these programs within the past six months. Your name or other unique identifier must be visible.
GRE Fee Reduction recipient
Website:
GRE Fee Reduction Program
Documentation Needed:
In the online application, upload the email showing that your request for an official GRE Fee Reduction Voucher was approved within the past 12 months. Your name or other unique identifier must be visible.
Residing in FEMA Declared Disaster Areas
Website:
Search Your Location - FEMA
Documentation Needed:
In the online application, upload a screenshot from FEMA locations showing your city, state, or zip, the named disaster, and active dates within six months.
Applicants from Qualifying Programs
DOCNET Recruiting Forum
Website:
DOCNET Upcoming Events
Documentation Needed:
In the online application, upload the official letter or email indicating current membership that began at least 12 months prior to the submission of your waiver request.
If you attended a conference within the past 12 months, upload a copy of the badge with your name or other unique identifier visible.
ENGINE
Website:
ENGINE
Documentation Needed:
In the online application, upload the official email from ENGINE showing that you successfully registered within the past 12 months. Your name and the email date should be visible.
Please Note: If you pay the application fee prior to being approved for a fee waiver, you will not be eligible for an application fee refund.
GEM Fellowship Program
GEM Fellowship
To request consideration for an application fee waiver as a GEM Fellowship applicant, you need to have already completed and submitted a GEM application via the eGEM portal. Then please complete the GEM Fellowship Fee Waiver Request Form.
Please ONLY complete the form if you are a GEM Fellowship applicant and you are requesting a fee waiver for the Georgia Tech graduate admission application.
When submitting your fee waiver request form, you will be asked to confirm (1) whether you are a U.S. Citizen or U.S. Permanent Resident, (2) the chosen degree program you are applying to, and (3) the college your chosen degree program is a part of.
Following the submission of your fee waiver request, please allow 48 hours to receive an email confirmation from the GEM Representative.
After you receive the reply that confirms you are an eligible GEM applicant, you must upload that email confirmation as part of your graduate admission application. Without this specific documentation, your request will be denied.
Online degree programs do not qualify for the GEM Fellowship. As a result, applicants to Georgia Tech’s online degree programs are not eligible for GEM-related fee waivers.
Please Note: If you pay the application fee prior to being confirmed by the Tech GEM Fellowship Representative as an eligible GEM applicant, you will not be eligible for an application fee refund.

Other Qualifying Applicants
Approved Georgia Tech bilateral exchange partners
Your application will qualify for a waiver of the fee based on the school information you provide in the application.
U.S. Veterans and U.S. Military Service Members
Documentation Needed:
Active Military or Reservist: In the online application, upload a copy of your Enlisted or Officer Record Brief (ERB/ORB) or a copy of your current military orders
Veterans: In the online application, upload a copy of your Certificate of Release or Discharge from Active Duty (DD-214) showing Honorable Character of Service on line 24
Reservists: In the online application, upload NGB 22
First-generation college students
Qualifications:
Applicant must be a U.S. Citizen or U.S. Permanent Resident and neither parent has earned a bachelor's degree (or equivalent).
Your application will be reviewed based on information you provide in the online application.
How to Request a Waiver
Requesting an application fee waiver is part of the online graduate admission application. Please follow these steps carefully to guarantee the efficient processing of your fee waiver request.
Please note that only one institute-level application fee waiver may be approved per admission cycle. Each admission cycle begins with Fall, followed by Spring, and ends with Summer. Once a waiver is approved, additional requests for the same cycle will not be accepted.
Confirm your eligibility for the requested fee waiver.
Ensure you submit valid documentation at the time of application. Inadequate documentation will result in the denial of your fee waiver request.
A decision on your fee waiver request will be communicated via email within 5-10 business days, along with any additional steps you need to follow.
Do not pay the application fee before receiving a decision on your waiver request. The application fee is non-refundable. As long as you have submitted your waiver request before the graduate program's deadline, your admission application will be counted as on time. If your waiver request gets approved, your admission application will then be queued for review by your chosen program. If your waiver request gets denied, you’ll be prompted to make payment before your admission application can be queued for review by your chosen program.
